svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Guided payroll activation solution architecture on Google Cloud: source systems feed ingestion services, a Python FastAPI service layer behind an API gateway serves a React frontend, with Pub/Sub, Workflows, Dataflow, Vertex AI, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Firestore and BigQuery, plus observability and security layers.
svg.text: Guided Payroll Activation: Solution Architecture on Google Cloud
Cloud Run, one service per epic
Delivery: Terraform, Cloud Build, Cloud Deploy, Artifact Registry, Binary Authorization. Tenant isolation: row-level security and per-tenant keys.
